title: Add isolated TDARR policy proof pack
summary: Added an external owned-media Policy Proof Pack catalog, source-fenced verification, copied sentinel-guarded materialization, backend-worker execution/reporting hooks, an operator wrapper, and primary Plex-client evidence guidance without changing media policy.
reason: The TDARR codec/container proof pack has no subtitle, Dynamic HDR, stream-topology, or device-playback fixtures, so high-risk media behavior needs a separate strict verification contract.
behavior_before: TDARR proof runs could validate codec/container inputs and source hashes but had no owned-media catalog, source mapping fence, per-scenario stream/HDR assertions, isolated policy report, or primary-client evidence handoff.
behavior_after: The Policy Proof Pack rejects missing, altered, escaped, or topology-mismatched owned fixtures before execution; materializes copied sources under a sentinel-marked root; records strict JSON/Markdown/CSV evidence; and invokes backend-owned workers and isolated pending drain only under that root.
manual_validation: Policy Proof Pack verify - expected guarded failure with actionable catalog SHA-256 message until owned fixtures are provisioned
PowerShell parser and CLI help - passed
bundled tooling suites - passed (35 tests total)

final bundled tooling suites - passed (35 tests)
policy proof CLI verify - expected structured preflight failure until owned sources/hashes are supplied
rollback_plan: Remove the Policy Proof Pack tool, catalog, operator wrapper, runbook, worksheet additions, dedicated root helpers, generated summaries, and this packet. The existing Tdarr Proof Pack and all pipeline media policy remain unchanged.
notes:

Covered policy proof source fencing, strictness, report generation, and scenario catalog.
Added the sanitized owned-fixture contract and scenario expectations.
Added canonical operator wrapper for policy proof verification and execution.
Documented fixture provisioning, strict execution, device checks, and safety boundaries.
Distinguished TDARR compatibility coverage from policy proof acceptance.
Added Policy Proof Pack and primary Plex client evidence section.
Indexed the Policy Proof Pack runbook.
Connected isolated soak interruption, publish, and backpressure validation to the Policy Proof Pack.
Refreshed generated summaries for Policy Proof Pack sources and evidence docs.
External owned fixtures are not provisioned in this workspace, so real-media/device validation remains operator work after catalog hashes and the local mapping are supplied.
Verify now emits structured JSON rather than a traceback for an unprovisioned catalog or fixture root.
Fixed backend execution materialization to re-copy only from the isolated source copy, never the owned fixture path.
